items.title: No mention of fossil fuels in latest COP31 draft deal
items.description: One of the most fraught debates at the UN climate talks in Turkey has revolved around the future of coal, oil and gas. Now, all mention of fossil fuels has been removed from the summit's new draft agreement.

items.title: New Ukraine talks including Europe to be held 'soon' — Merz
items.description: Germany's Chancellor Friedrich Merz says European leaders could take part in fresh Ukraine talks on "neutral ground." The UK and EU countries have urged a seat at the table in meetings between the US, Russia and Ukraine.

items.title: European leaders present united front in push for peace in Ukraine
items.description: Talks in Berlin end with reaffirmed support for Kyiv and a concerted push for European representation at future peace talks to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
